modified.note: Ingested by pipeline/ingest.py: structures split and labelled, pose normalised, decimated for interactive display, exported to glTF, and voxelised to a labelled echo volume at 192^3. No geometry was added, sculpted, or invented. ORIENTATION UNVERIFIED. This source carries no chamber labels, so anterior and patient-left cannot be derived from the geometry. The declared convention is the glTF default (+y up) with the remaining axes unconfirmed, and must be set at vetting before any clinical use. REJECTED AS SUBSTRATE (2026-08-19). A single undivided tissue body: one material, one echo label, no per-chamber structures, so nothing can be shown or hidden per chamber and a sweep has no ordered structure list to read out. Interior endocardial surfaces are genuinely present, but 1,026 connected components — trabecular islands and segmentation debris — render as voids through the tissue. NOT PUBLISHED, and independently licence-constrained as CC BY-NC 4.0. Retained in the repository as evidence. Renders in an UNVERIFIED orientation. NON-COMMERCIAL. Shipping this pack binds the whole app: build_plan.md's NC red lines are ads, paid sponsorship tied to content, paid tiers including NC content, and selling institutional access. A free educational app with zero revenue is squarely permitted. Kept logically separable so it can be dropped without touching the others.

blood_pool_decision.evidence: a single undivided STL with no groups, no tags and no labels. There is nothing in this source to match against, and it models no cavity as an object — the interior endocardial surfaces are part of the same tissue body — so the one structure is tissue, decided here rather than left to fall through as false.
